crossRefs.note: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that…
for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword…

translations.web: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.
translations.bsb: your elders and judges must come out and measure the distance from the victim to the neighboring cities.
translations.kjv: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth, and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain:
